message.content:
{"diagnosis": "Fetch test with 256 NOPs (ADDI) asserted cpu trap and returned FAIL 0xdead instead of forward progress. instr_trap was 1 for a legal instruction instead of 0. Root cause at line 679: `assign instr_trap = (CATCH_ILLINSN || WITH_PCPI) || !{...}` uses OR so with CATCH_ILLINSN set every decode traps; it must be AND to trap only on illegal opcode.", "patch_diff": "diff --git a/picorv32.v b/picorv32.v
--- a/picorv32.v
+++ b/picorv32.v
@@ -679,1 +679,1 @@
-	assign instr_trap = (CATCH_ILLINSN || WITH_PCPI) || !{instr_lui, instr_auipc, instr_jal, instr_jalr,
+	assign instr_trap = (CATCH_ILLINSN || WITH_PCPI) && !{instr_lui, instr_auipc, instr_jal, instr_jalr,", "expected": "tohost: PASS with no cpu trap asserted, fetch alignment + progress OK"}
